name: Apify MCP server
summary: Apify's hosted MCP server at mcp.apify.com lets an agent search the Apify Store, read Actor details, run Actors, read runs and storage, and search the vendor's docs; its page lists 29 tools. The vendor says four discovery and docs tools work without an account when the tools query parameter names only them, and on 2026-10-19 it held: the default endpoint answered 401 keyless; the documented four-tool URL answered initialize, tools/list and one docs search with no account. An agent can also buy a prepaid, spend-capped API token through x402 or MPP at agi.apify.com; both answered 402 unpaid.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-19: the default endpoint answered 401 (OAuth or an API token); the documented no-account URL (?tools= the four discovery and docs tools) answered initialize and tools/list 200, four read-only tools, one docs search made. Actor runs need a token, bought or from an account.

payments.notes: 2026-10-19: agi.apify.com sells a prepaid, spend-capped API token (minimum $1, 14-day TTL, non-refundable, its words): x402 402, USDC on Base or Solana, USDT on Solana; MPP 402, four charge challenges on Tempo and Solana. Plans: Free $0, no card; Starter $19, Scale $199, Business $999 a month.

jobs.summary: The vendor's tool table: search-apify-docs 'Search the Apify documentation for relevant pages', fetch-apify-docs 'Fetch the full content of an Apify documentation page by its URL', both 'enabled for unauthenticated use'. Measured keyless 2026-10-19: one search returned the vendor's own MCP page.
